parameters.content: Run the Supabase migrations in supabase/migrations in order. This workflow only verifies the shared medical schema; it does not create SaaS, shopping, customers, or orders tables.

parameters.query: SELECT to_regclass('public.profiles') AS profiles, to_regclass('public.doctor_profiles') AS doctor_profiles, to_regclass('public.patient_profiles') AS patient_profiles, to_regclass('public.appointments') AS appointments, to_regclass('public.support_tickets') AS support_tickets, to_regclass('public.conversations') AS conversations, to_regclass('public.messages') AS messages, to_regclass('public.lab_results') AS lab_results;
